decisions.statement: A page type is handed to the mechanical change taking every page of one away.
Every page of that page type is that change's one answer.
A count is handed on and bounds how many pages that change takes away.
A count left out takes away every page of that page type.
A count that is no whole number above nothing is refused here.
The caller reaches this change again to take away the pages a count left.
A refusal from that change is the refusal this act gives.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
No change but that one rung is reached.

definition: every page of one page type taken away, each with the files beside it
